findings.category: other:business_flow (loyalty redemption offers more than the order and dead-ends) — code path, not captured
findings.evidence: On a 3,50 € order the payment page offers 'Tu as 1250 pts, utilisables : 1200 pts (−12,00 €)' with a 'Utiliser' button (DOM text in SE1-33, A-88, A-91 and AND-33). funnel.jsx:440-442 computes usable = floor(balance/rate)*rate with no cap at the order amount, and funnel.jsx:460 sets ctx.discount = 12.00 on tap. In PaymentPage, funnel.jsx:1866-1869 then gives rawDiscount 12 > subtotal 3,50, so discountClamped is true. canProceed is false (funnel.jsx:1884), and funnel.jsx:2208-2212 shows 'Ta remise (12,00 €) dépasse maintenant le montant de ta commande. Ajoute un article, ou saisis à nouveau ton code…'. The customer used points, not a code. The backend would have clamped it itself (DiscountCalculator.php:49 'min($requestedDiscount, $realSubtotal)', then floor to whole points). So any loyalty customer whose order is below the usable value (1000 pts = 10 € minimum, so a 6,90 € Tacos M or a 7,40 € Cayenne) is blocked after tapping 'Utiliser' until they find 'Retirer'. Not exercised by the bench (no capture after the tap), so it stays P2 until a second method confirms it. It would be P1 if a capture confirms it.
findings.fix_hint: Cap the preview at the order: usable = min(usableRaw, floor(subtotal*rate/... )*...) or send the points and let the server clamp, and never route a loyalty discount into the 'code' clamp message. Add a bench state: 1250 pts + 3,50 € cart → tap Utiliser → CTA must stay enabled.
